query: What concrete experimental aging protocol (temperature/humidity cycles, burial microcosms, microbial exposure, duration) will we standardize to produce comparable wear and adhesive residue signatures?

response.query: What concrete experimental aging protocol (temperature/humidity cycles, burial microcosms, microbial exposure, duration) will we standardize to produce comparable wear and adhesive residue signatures?
response.answer: Standardize aging protocol with 50°C/75% humidity cycles, 1-year burial, and microbial exposure. Use consistent duration for wear and residue analysis.
